faq.question: Q1. What is MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MAIDS Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment notification issued by Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, New Delhi, to fill 2 posts under the National Resource Centre for Oral Health and Tobacco Cessation on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, divided between Project Research Scientist- III (Medical) (1 vacancy) and Young Professional-II (I.T.) (1 vacancy).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit completed applications by hand or by Indian Post is 24/10/2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Research Scientist- III (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BDS + MDS in Public Health Dentistry with 3 Years Post Qualification Experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Young Professional-II (I.T.)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Young Professional-II (I.T.) is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MAIDS Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach self-attested documents, and submit it offline by hand or via Indian Post to Room No: 501, 5th Floor Phase-II, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, New Delhi, M.A.M.C Complex, B.S. Zafar Marg New Delhi -110002.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MAIDS posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on eligibility criteria, followed by an Interview for the Project Research Scientist- III (Medical) post, and a Skill Test followed by Interview for the Young Professional-II (I.T.) post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated contractual remuneration is Rs. 1,20,900/- per month for Project Research Scientist- III (Medical) and Rs. 42,000/- per month for Young Professional-II (I.T.).

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent positions?
faq.answer: No, these posts are temporary, created for the project "National Resource Centre for Oral Health and Tobacco Cessation" up to 31st March, 2027, and incumbents will have no right to regular appointment.
